additional_info.subject: RE: 0376697 - ID0376697-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S1 170003220] Outlet 2 is not working CRM:00641000642
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr.Benjamin,
I hope you are doing well.
We have reviewed the logs on the SCB, and based on our analysis, we have identified multiple instances of the following error:
"Polling coap://10.20.17.100:5683/state Error: No reply in 4.25s."
This indicates that the SECC Lite is unable to communicate with the controller. Please refer to the snapshot below, where you can see the error captured multiple times.
Could you please assist with the following actions:
Confirm whether the Dlogic controller update has been completed.
Set an overnight automatic reboot (at least every two days).
Please do not recommend replacing the HMI at this time, as there is no evidence suggesting that the issue is hardware related.
Your prompt attention to this matter is appreciated.
Best regards,
Abhinav Malokar
